summary: Zhihu Inc., a Hong Kong-listed WVR issuer trading under 02390 and also registered with the SEC, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its routine monthly Hong Kong Exchange return on movements in securities for the month ended August 31, 2026. Authorized capital, issued shares, and treasury shares were unchanged; public float compliance is confirmed at the applicable 25% threshold. The return reflects only ordinary share-option activity and bulk ADS issuance mechanics, with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, special dividend, or other special situation. It functions as a US-equivalent routine current report; the risk-arb angle is nil.
